requirements.statement: As a Customer, I want to keep my name, address and phone number, and optionally one bank account, on record with the shop, so that my orders can be delivered to me and I can be contacted about them.

acceptance_criteria.text: Each customer record holds a name, an address and a phone number.
A customer has at most one bank account, and the bank account is optional.
Given a customer record in which the name, the address or the phone number is absent, When the record is saved, Then the system rejects the record and stores no customer.
Given a customer record with a name, an address and a phone number but no bank account, When the record is saved, Then the system stores the customer without a bank account.

requirements.statement: As a Customer, I want to browse the products on offer with their name, description, price and image, so that I can decide which products to order.

acceptance_criteria.text: Each product holds a name, a description, a price and an image.
The price of a product is a decimal number.

Given a product record in which the name, the description, the price or the image is absent, When the record is saved, Then the system rejects the record and the product does not appear among the products on offer.
A product may be referred to by any number of order items, including none.
Given a product that is referred to by order items of an order, When that order is removed, Then the product continues to exist.

requirements.statement: As a Customer, I want to submit an order for one or more products with a payment method of my choice, so that I can purchase the products I need.

acceptance_criteria.text: Given a known customer, one or more order items each referring to an existing product, and a payment method, When the customer submits the order, Then the system registers an order with the submission date as its order date and the status submitted.
Given an order submission that names a customer not known to the system, When the submission is made, Then the system rejects it and registers no order.
Given an order submission that contains no order item, When the submission is made, Then the system rejects it and registers no order.
Given an order submission in which an order item refers to a product that does not exist, When the submission is made, Then the system rejects it and registers no order.
The total amount of a registered order equals the sum over its order items of quantity multiplied by unit price.
Each order records an order date, a total amount, a status and a payment method, none of which may be absent.
Each order item records a quantity, a unit price and a reference to exactly one product, none of which may be absent, and belongs to exactly one order.
An order item exists only as part of the order it belongs to, cannot be moved to another order, and is removed when that order is removed.
Each order belongs to exactly one customer, and a customer may have any number of orders.
The unit price of an order item and the total amount of an order are decimal numbers.
The status of an order takes only the values submitted, pending, filled, shipped or closed.
The payment method of an order takes only the values bank, card or cash.
A newly registered order has the status submitted, from which its status may change only to pending.

requirements.statement: As an Accountant, I want to raise an invoice for an order that has been filled, so that the customer is billed for the goods supplied.

acceptance_criteria.text: Given an order whose status is filled or shipped and that has no invoice, When the accountant raises an invoice for it with a date, an amount and a payment method, Then the system records the invoice for that order with the status issued.
Given an order that already has an invoice, When the accountant requests a further invoice for it, Then the system rejects the request and the order keeps its single invoice.
Given an order whose status is submitted, pending or closed, When the accountant requests an invoice for it, Then the system rejects the request and records no invoice.
Given an order that has been declined, When the accountant requests an invoice for it, Then the system rejects the request and records no invoice.

Given an order whose status is filled and that has not been shipped, When the accountant raises an invoice for it, Then the system records the invoice without requiring the order to have been shipped.
Each invoice records a date, an amount, a status and a payment method, none of which may be absent.
An order has at most one invoice, and each invoice is associated with exactly one order.
The amount of an invoice is a decimal number.
The status of an invoice takes only the values issued or paid.
The payment method of an invoice takes only the values bank, card or cash.
A newly raised invoice has the status issued, from which its status may change only to paid.

requirements.statement: As a Customer, I want to submit a payment against an invoice I have received, so that I can settle the amount I owe for my order.

acceptance_criteria.text: Given an invoice whose status is issued, When the customer submits a payment against it with a date, an amount and a payment method, Then the system records the payment against that invoice with the status pending.
Given an invoice whose status is paid, When the customer submits a payment against it, Then the system rejects the payment and records no payment.

Given an invoice whose earlier payment has the status failed, When the customer submits a further payment against it, Then the system records the further payment as a separate payment with the status pending and the earlier payment keeps the status failed.
Each payment records a date, an amount, a status and a payment method, none of which may be absent.
An invoice may have any number of payments, and each payment is recorded against exactly one invoice and never directly against an order.
The amount of a payment is a decimal number.
The status of a payment takes only the values pending, completed or failed.
The payment method of a payment takes only the values bank, card or cash.
A newly submitted payment has the status pending, from which its status may change only to completed or to failed.

requirements.statement: As an OrderStaff, I want to receive a submitted order, so that I take responsibility for validating and fulfilling it.

acceptance_criteria.text: Given an order whose status is submitted, When order staff receive it, Then the system sets its status to pending.
Given an order whose status is not submitted, When order staff attempt to receive it, Then the system rejects the attempt and the status of the order is unchanged.
Given an order whose status is closed, When order staff attempt to receive it, Then the system rejects the attempt and the order keeps the status closed.
Receiving an order changes its status only from submitted to pending.

requirements.statement: As an OrderStaff, I want to mark a pending order as filled, so that the order is ready to be shipped and invoiced.

acceptance_criteria.text: Given an order whose status is pending, When order staff mark it as filled, Then the system sets its status to filled.
Given an order whose status is not pending, When order staff attempt to mark it as filled, Then the system rejects the attempt and the status of the order is unchanged.
Given an order whose status is closed, When order staff attempt to mark it as filled, Then the system rejects the attempt and the order keeps the status closed.
Marking an order as filled changes its status only from pending to filled.

requirements.statement: As an OrderStaff, I want to decline a pending order, so that an order the business will not fulfil is closed without being shipped or billed.

acceptance_criteria.text: Given an order whose status is pending, When order staff decline it, Then the system sets its status to closed.
Given an order whose status is not pending, When order staff attempt to decline it, Then the system rejects the attempt and the status of the order is unchanged.
Given an order whose status is closed, When order staff attempt to decline it, Then the system rejects the attempt and the order keeps the status closed.
Given an order that has been declined, When an accountant requests an invoice for it, Then the system rejects the request and the order remains without an invoice.
Declining an order changes its status only from pending to closed.

requirements.statement: As an OrderStaff, I want to set a filled order to shipped, so that it is known that the goods are on their way to the customer.

acceptance_criteria.text: Given an order whose status is filled, When order staff set it to shipped, Then the system sets its status to shipped.
Given an order whose status is not filled, When order staff attempt to set it to shipped, Then the system rejects the attempt and the status of the order is unchanged.
Given an order that has an invoice with payments against it, When order staff set the order to shipped, Then the status of the invoice and the status of every payment against it are unchanged.
Given an order whose status is filled and that has no invoice, When order staff set it to shipped, Then the system sets its status to shipped without requiring an invoice to have been raised.
Given an order whose status is closed, When order staff attempt to set it to shipped, Then the system rejects the attempt and the order keeps the status closed.
Setting an order to shipped changes its status only from filled to shipped.

requirements.statement: As an Accountant, I want to confirm a pending payment once the money has been received, so that the invoice it settles is recorded as paid.

acceptance_criteria.text: Given a payment whose status is pending, When the accountant confirms it, Then the system sets its status to completed.
Given a pending payment against an invoice whose status is issued, When the accountant confirms the payment, Then the system sets the status of that invoice to paid.
Given a pending payment against an invoice whose status is already paid, When the accountant confirms the payment, Then the system sets the payment to completed and the invoice keeps the status paid.
Given a pending payment against an invoice that bills an order, When the accountant confirms the payment, Then the status of that order is unchanged.
Given a payment whose status is not pending, When the accountant attempts to confirm it, Then the system rejects the attempt and the status of the payment is unchanged.
Confirming a payment changes the status of the payment only from pending to completed and the status of its invoice only from issued to paid.

requirements.statement: As an Accountant, I want to reject a pending payment that has not been honoured, so that the invoice stays open for the customer to pay again.

acceptance_criteria.text: Given a payment whose status is pending, When the accountant rejects it, Then the system sets its status to failed.
Given a pending payment against an invoice that bills an order, When the accountant rejects the payment, Then the status of the invoice and the status of the order are unchanged.
Given a payment whose status is not pending, When the accountant attempts to reject it, Then the system rejects the attempt and the status of the payment is unchanged.
Rejecting a payment changes its status only from pending to failed.

requirements.statement: As an OrderStaff, I want to close a shipped order whose invoice has been paid, so that completed orders are set apart from orders that still need work.

acceptance_criteria.text: Given an order whose status is shipped and whose invoice has the status paid, When order staff close it, Then the system sets its status to closed.

Given an order whose status is shipped and that has no invoice or whose invoice does not have the status paid, When order staff attempt to close it, Then the system rejects the attempt and the status of the order is unchanged.
Given an order whose invoice has the status paid and whose status is not shipped, When order staff attempt to close it, Then the system rejects the attempt and the status of the order is unchanged.
A filled order is closed only after both its shipping and the settlement of its invoice have completed, whichever of the two finishes last.
Once an order has the status closed, its status never changes again.
Closing an order changes its status only from shipped to closed.

requirements.statement: When a user submits an order containing up to 50 order items under normal operating conditions, the system shall register the order and respond within 2 seconds for at least 95% of submissions.
Under normal operating conditions, the system shall support at least 200 concurrent users and at least 20 order submissions per second while meeting the response time stated in NFR-01.
The system shall authenticate every user before granting access to any customer, order, invoice or payment data, and shall reject 100% of unauthenticated requests.
The system shall allow only users holding the Accountant role to confirm or reject a payment, and shall reject 100% of such requests from users who do not hold that role.
The system shall encrypt customer personal data and bank account numbers in transit using TLS 1.2 or higher and shall store them encrypted at rest.
The system shall record the user and the time of every status change of an order, an invoice and a payment, and shall retain each such record for at least 12 months.
The system shall be available for at least 99.5% of each calendar month, excluding scheduled maintenance announced at least 24 hours in advance.
When a server failure occurs, the system shall resume accepting requests within 15 minutes and shall lose none of the orders, invoices and payments recorded before the failure.
